title: Senior IT Infrastructure & Network Engineer (L2/L3)
description:
Job Title: Senior IT Infrastructure & Network Engineer (L2/L3)  
Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat  
Shift: Rotational (US & UK shifts, including night shifts)  
Experience: 3 years  
Employment Type: Full-time, Work from Office

About the Role:  
We are looking for an experienced Senior IT Infrastructure & Network Engineer in Ahmedabad to own core networking, security, servers and communication systems for our international clients. The candidate will act as the escalation point for the L1 team, handle complex issues independently, and ensure network, security and system uptime.

Key Responsibilities:

Network & Security

* Configure, manage and troubleshoot Sophos firewalls: policies, NAT, VPN (site-to-site and remote access), web filtering, IPS and firmware updates
* Manage core networking: LAN/WAN design, VLANs, inter-VLAN routing, STP, link aggregation and network segmentation
* Configure and troubleshoot L2/L3 switches (Cisco, HP/Aruba, D-Link or similar)
* Configure and manage routing: static routes, OSPF/BGP basics, ISP links, failover and load balancing
* Configure and manage wireless access points and controllers: SSIDs, security, roaming and coverage
* Monitor network security, review logs and respond to security incidents
* Implement security best practices, access control and patch management

Servers & Systems

* Administer Windows Server: Active Directory, DNS, DHCP, Group Policy, file and print services
* Install, maintain and back up SQL Server databases; handle basic performance checks and user access
* Manage Microsoft 365: user and license management, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint/OneDrive and security settings
* Manage server backups, restoration and disaster recovery readiness

Communication & Devices

* Configure and support RingCentral and Vonage cloud telephony: users, extensions, call routing and number setup
* Install, configure and troubleshoot IP phones
* Configure and maintain eSSL biometric attendance and access control devices, including network integration
* Manage power backup systems (UPS) and ensure uptime of critical infrastructure

Team & Process

* Act as the L2/L3 escalation point and mentor L1 engineers
* Handle critical tickets and outages within SLA, with root cause analysis
* Maintain network diagrams, configuration backups and documentation
* Coordinate with ISPs, vendors and OEMs for support and replacements
* Proactively identify risks and recommend infrastructure improvements

Required Skills:

* Strong hands-on experience with Sophos firewall
* Strong knowledge of switching, routing and core networking (TCP/IP, VLANs, subnetting, VPN, NAT)
* Windows Server administration and Active Directory
* SQL Server installation, backup and basic administration
* Microsoft 365 administration
* RingCentral and Vonage telephony, plus IP phone setup
* Wireless access point configuration
* eSSL device configuration and UPS / power backup management
* Excellent English communication for US/UK clients
* Strong troubleshooting, ownership and ability to work under pressure

Preferred:

* CCNA / CCNP, Sophos Certified Engineer/Architect, Microsoft (MCSA / Azure / M365) certifications
* Experience in managed services or supporting international clients

Qualification:  
B.E. / B.Tech / BCA / MCA or equivalent in IT, Computer Science or related field

Shift Requirement:  
Must be comfortable with rotational US and UK shifts, including nights and weekends as per roster, and on-call support during critical issues.

title: Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION

Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer

Experience 1.5 to 2 years

Department IT / Information Security

Employment Type Full-Time

Industry Fintech / NBFC

Location Ahmedabad, Gujarat

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive Cyber Security & Infrastructure Engineer with 1.5 years or more of relevant experience in IT infrastructure, cybersecurity operations, network security, system administration, and security monitoring. The candidate will help maintain a secure and reliable technology environment by implementing security controls, monitoring infrastructure, managing vulnerabilities, and supporting applicable regulatory and audit requirements.

Key Responsibilities

Cybersecurity Operations

* Monitor security alerts, system logs, and suspicious activities to identify potential threats.
* Support vulnerability assessments, penetration testing coordination, and remediation tracking.
* Help protect sensitive customer information, personally identifiable information (PII), and financial data.
* Support endpoint protection (antivirus/EDR), firewall, and intrusion detection/prevention controls.
* Assist with security incident investigation, documentation, escalation, and root cause analysis.
* Support Data Loss Prevention (DLP) controls to reduce unauthorized data sharing or transfers.

IT Infrastructure & Network Security

* Administer and monitor servers, operating systems, network devices, and cloud infrastructure.
* Support firewall rules, VPNs, access controls, network segmentation, and secure remote access.
* Perform system hardening, security patching, and operating system updates.
* Monitor infrastructure availability, performance, backups, and security configurations.
* Support cloud security and identity/access management in platforms such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, or Azure.
* Assist with backup, disaster recovery (DR), and business continuity (BCP) activities.

Identity & Access Management

* Manage user access provisioning, modification, and deactivation based on approved requests.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC), least privilege, and multi-factor authentication (MFA).
* Conduct periodic access reviews and identify inactive, excessive, or privileged access.

Security Compliance & Audit

* Support cybersecurity and IT control requirements applicable to an RBI-regulated NBFC.
* Assist with internal/external audits, VAPT, evidence collection, and audit response.
* Maintain asset inventories, access review records, patch reports, incident logs, and security documentation.
* Track audit observations and coordinate timely remediation with relevant teams and vendors.

Monitoring, Reporting & Incident Response

* Monitor events using available SIEM, EDR, firewall, and infrastructure monitoring tools.
* Escalate critical security incidents and infrastructure issues promptly.
* Prepare periodic reports on vulnerabilities, patch compliance, access reviews, security alerts, and infrastructure health.
* Coordinate with development, infrastructure, and third-party vendor teams to resolve security issues.

Required Technical Skills

* Networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, VPNs, routing, and firewall fundamentals.
* Operating Systems: Windows Server and Linux administration.
* Security Tools: Exposure to firewalls, antivirus/EDR, vulnerability scanners, and SIEM platforms.
* Infrastructure: Server administration, patch management, backup solutions, and basic cloud security.
* Security Fundamentals: Vulnerability management, system hardening, access control, incident response, and log analysis.
* Cloud Platforms: Basic knowledge of Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, or Microsoft Azure.
* Scripting: Basic Python, PowerShell, or Bash scripting is an advantage.
* Documentation: Ability to maintain technical documentation, security reports, and audit evidence.

Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.
* Minimum 1.5 years of relevant experience in cybersecurity, IT infrastructure, network administration, or information security operations.
* Certifications such as CompTIA Security+, CCNA, Microsoft Security, or cloud security certifications are preferred, not mandatory.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Understanding of confidentiality and secure handling of customer information.
* Ability to coordinate with internal teams, auditors, and external technology vendors.
* Proactive approach to identifying and resolving security risks.
* Good communication, documentation, and incident reporting skills.

Preferred Certifications  
CompTIA Security+  
Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH)  
ISO 27001 Lead Implementer

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely identification, tracking, and remediation of vulnerabilities.
* Security patch compliance across servers and endpoints.
* Timely closure of security audit observations.
* Completion of access reviews and appropriate privileged account controls.
* Timely detection, escalation, and documentation of security incidents.
* Monitoring of backup jobs and participation in recovery tests.
* Adherence to approved security policies and infrastructure hardening standards.

Note: The role supports the organization’s cybersecurity and infrastructure controls in line with applicable regulatory requirements, internal policies, and the organization’s risk profile.

Pay: ₹400,000.00 - ₹800,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund
* Work from home
